title: The Forest's Relics
_about: The main story's last reward (main_story:epilogue, a choice reward): each player picks one. Dylan, 2026-10-15: finishing the story should be epic, with unbreakable gear rather than a diamond sword.

rewards.name: Wren's Thornblade
lore: Ignis's own fire, quenched in the forest's spring.

rewards.name: The Greenheart Codex
lore: Every page smells of rain and moss.

rewards.name: The Old Root
lore: It digs like a root finds water.
